in_marathi.name: Ayansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayansh is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound name consisting of two parts – Ay and Ansh. Ay means 'Lord' and Ansh means 'World'. Thus, Ayansh can be interpreted as 'Lord of the World'.
